root.name: Danish Gambit Declined: Sörensen Defense
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. d4 exd4 3. c3 d5

overview: Black declines the gambit by striking at the centre with 3...d5. After 4.exd5 Qxd5 5.cxd4 White recovers the pawn and has an isolated d-pawn with open lines for the pieces, while Black has easy development. The position is level and open, and neither side is behind in material.

white_ideas.idea: Recapture on d4, develop Nc3 and Nf3 and use the open lines
Play for the initiative against the Black queen on d5

black_ideas.idea: Develop smoothly with ...Nf6, ...Nc6 and ...Bb4+ and target the d4 pawn
Trade pieces to reach an easy equality

typical_structures.structure: Isolated d4 pawn for White against a symmetrical set-up, open central files

character.notes: Open but even; Black has no real risks.

gambit.notes: Declined; White regains the pawn on d4.

soundness.notes: A good equalising line for Black.

structure.notes: Central pawns exchanged, open lines for pieces.

character.reason: Open but level play without much risk.

soundness.reason: A good equalising line for Black.

structure.reason: Central pawns come off, leaving open lines.

approach.reason: A normal reply to the Danish.

plans.reason: White gets an isolated d-pawn and active pieces.
